plan_review.notes: Adversarial review considered: Alt A state-only Slice 3 with quest integration deferred (rejected because issue explicitly requires quest-event projection, but we will avoid HUD overreach); Alt B programmatic TS quest-pack builder from constants (rejected as broader than needed; add drift validation for static pack instead); Alt C pure reducer/event seam (partially adopted by driving exported runtime helpers through the real floorObjectiveTick path instead of provider-only autoprogression). Adopted changes: do not call questSystem inside floor5ObjectiveTick, make terminal/non-playing ticks no-op so defeat precedence wins, avoid provider-only headless shortcut, add static-pack/goal-ID validation, add parity/idempotency coverage, and phrase Slice 3 completion as reaching all Slice 3 latches rather than floor victory.
